title: D1: one review per task by the other model; spec review from complexity 6 on sonnet; thresholds in pool.toml [review]
spec:
Why: 2026-09-18 every fallback-executed task got two reviews (daemon sonnet + hand-added opus), and spec reviews ran on opus at 1.26 USD each; reviews cost as much as execution. Policy: complexity 1-3 hooks only (unchanged); 4-6 exactly one review, tier = the model that did not execute (C-O6 review_tier); 7-10 two reviews, the second on the other account with the other model (spawn.run_worker avoid, from C-O6b); spec review only for complexity >= 6, tier sonnet. Implement: daemon.py reads thresholds from pool.cfg.get("review", {}) with keys spec_review_min (default 6), direct_merge_max (3), two_reviews_from (7) and spec_review_tier ("sonnet"), replacing the SPEC_REVIEW_MIN / DIRECT_MERGE_MAX constants (keep the names as module attributes for tests, populated from cfg at tick). gate(): when a review for the task already exists (any status), do not create another unless complexity >= two_reviews_from and only one exists; merge_reviewed(): for two_reviews_from and up, merge only when every review of the task approved; for one-review tasks, on the first approve as today. Add [review] to .orchestrator/pool.toml with the defaults and a comment stating the policy and the measurement that motivated it. README.md "Pipeline": rewrite the review sentence. Tests in tests/test_daemon.py: one_review_only_for_mid_complexity (a second gate pass creates no second review), two_reviews_for_high_complexity_merge_waits_for_both, spec_review_threshold_from_cfg (complexity 5 dispatches without spec review, 6 gets one on sonnet), defaults_when_review_table_missing.
(Recreated from T-0110: re-pointed at C-O3 v4)
acceptance: tests/test_daemon.py gains the four named tests; all green with existing tests untouched
With the committed pool.toml a complexity-5 task dispatches without spec review and a complexity-4 done task gets exactly one review on the model the executor did not use
pool.toml has a [review] table with the four keys and a comment; README Pipeline paragraph matches the policy
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green; no new dependency

Committed clean at `cf7ad84`.

## Summary

Implemented the tiered review-cost policy in `orchestrator/daemon.py`, reading thresholds from `pool.toml`'s new `[review]` table instead of hardcoded constants:

- `spec_review_min` (6), `direct_merge_max` (3), `two_reviews_from` (7), `spec_review_tier` ("sonnet") — kept as module attributes (`daemon.SPEC_REVIEW_MIN` etc.), refreshed from `pool.cfg.get("review", {})` at the top of every `tick()` via new `_load_review_cfg()`.
- `dispatch()`: spec review only fires at complexity ≥ `SPEC_REVIEW_MIN`, tagged with `tier=SPEC_REVIEW_TIER`.
- `gate()`: complexity ≤ `DIRECT_MERGE_MAX` still merges straight through; complexity above that gets one review (tiered to whichever model didn't execute, via the existing `review_tier()`); complexity ≥ `TWO_REVIEWS_FROM` gets a second review on the opposite tier (`_other_tier()`), guarded so a re-entry never creates a duplicate. Orphaned-result tasks keep the single-review path unconditionally.
- `merge_reviewed()`: added `_review_verdict()` to read each review's own `review_verdict`/`result` first (a second review completing overwrites the shared field on the source task, so relying on that field alone would lose the first review's verdict). For `complexity >= TWO_REVIEWS_FROM`, merge only fires once every sibling review is done and approved; a single `request_changes` still holds immediately as before.

**Files changed:** `orchestrator/daemon.py`, `tests/test_daemon.py`, `.orchestrator/pool.toml`, `README.md`.

**Tests added** (all in `tests/test_daemon.py`): `test_one_review_only_for_mid_complexity`, `test_two_reviews_for_high_complexity_merge_waits_for_both`, `test_spec_review_threshold_from_cfg`, `test_defaults_when_review_table_missing`.

Test output: 160/160 green (`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests`), no failures. `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` gate exits 0.
